rows.definition: Bounded logical resident-slot replacement policy in modelloadplan adapted from llama.cpp ClassLRU (src/llama-moe-cache.cpp, MIT). Eight frequency-class LRU lists retain exponentially decayed CRF across eviction, and Plan chooses, among the oldest unselected candidate of each class, the one with the largest age divided by 2^class. Per-layer int64 token clocks advance per Plan call, methods serialize access through a mutex, and a returned slot is not evidence that weights are loaded.
rows.distinction: Host-side logical residency planning over simulated slots and token clocks - not physical weight placement (ExpertCacheTier), not the live paged-ring victim ranking ExpertRingEvictLRU, and not the ctxmmu two-ring ExpertResidencyPolicy that owns a real ResidencyBacking store.

rows.definition: Constructor validating layers, experts, and residentSlots geometry: all positive, experts <= ExpertCacheLRFUMaxEntries, layers*experts bounded via a division check before allocation, and residentSlots <= layers*experts; refusal returns ErrExpertCacheLRFUConfig. On success it allocates empty slots, zero layer clocks, and eight empty class lists.
rows.distinction: Initializes policy metadata only - not weight allocation, cache warm-start, or a per-token Plan transition; its sole refusal is the construction-time ErrExpertCacheLRFUConfig, unlike the access-time input sentinel.

rows.definition: Result of one ExpertCacheLRFU.Plan transition: the resident hit count, the selected layer's token clock before and after the increment, and the ordered list of fill observations. Invalid, capacity, and clock refusals leave policy state unchanged.
rows.distinction: Summarizes one policy transition (hits, clock interval, ordered fills) rather than a single fill record or an Inspect observation, and proves nothing about loader I/O or device completion.

rows.definition: One logical cache-plan miss result: the selected ExpertCacheKey, the assigned resident slot, and an optional owned copy of the evicted expert key. Nil Evicted means an unused slot rather than an unknown victim.
rows.distinction: Records one simulated placement decision, not a completed weight transfer; it is an element of an ExpertCacheLRFUPlan result, not the whole transition, and not a trace event that merely names a selected expert.

rows.definition: Owned scalar snapshot returned by Inspect for one expert: resident slot (-1 when nonresident), resident class as of last use, retained CRF, currently decayed CRF, last-use token (-1 before first access), and layer clock. It is an observation without mutation.
rows.distinction: An Inspect observation, not a Plan result; its Class is the last-use resident bucket, not a live recompute as the layer clock ages, and its CRF persists after eviction.

rows.definition: Public constant 1<<20 bounding the logical layer-times-expert entries accepted by NewExpertCacheLRFU; the constructor checks it using division before allocating arrays.
rows.distinction: Bounds policy metadata geometry (layer-times-expert entries), not the requested resident slot count, not byte capacity, and not the eight frequency-class count.

rows.definition: Unexported constant 8 fixing the number of frequency buckets into which ExpertCacheLRFU organizes its resident slots, one LRU list per bucket with matching head/tail arrays.
rows.distinction: The bucket count organizing resident slots into per-class LRU lists - not the metadata entry capacity bound (ExpertCacheLRFUMaxEntries) and not physical weight-storage tiers; the sibling expertCacheLRFUClass function maps a CRF value into these buckets.

rows.definition: Unexported float32 constant 128 giving the per-layer token-clock half-life used by the decayed method: retained CRF is multiplied by Exp2(-age/halfLife), where age is measured in layer-clock tokens since last use.
rows.distinction: A token-age decay constant for CRF, not wall-clock duration, not the class count, and not an eviction deadline; the victim choice separately scores age divided by 2^class.

rows.definition: Unexported bucketing function mapping a post-use CRF to a frequency class: log2 of the CRF is computed as float32 before integer truncation, preserving the donor std::log2(float) rounding near powers of two, and the result is capped at the last of eight classes.
rows.distinction: Computes the frequency bucket for a CRF value - not the victim age score (which divides age by 2^class in victim) and not the stored per-slot class observed by Inspect.

rows.definition: Sentinel error refused by NewExpertCacheLRFU for nonpositive geometry, excessive logical entries, or resident slots exceeding layer-times-expert entries.
rows.distinction: Rejects policy construction geometry, unlike ErrExpertCacheLRFUInput which rejects an access to an existing policy; it is never returned by Plan or Inspect.

rows.definition: Sentinel error refused by Plan and Inspect for a nil receiver, an out-of-range layer or expert ID, a negative token increment, or a selected expert id outside the configured range.
rows.distinction: Malformed-access refusal, not valid selections exceeding resident slots (ErrExpertCacheLRFUCapacity) and not token-clock overflow (ErrExpertCacheLRFUClock); it also guards construction-free reads via Inspect.

rows.definition: Sentinel error refused by Plan when the distinct selected experts exceed the available logical resident slots, before any policy state changes.
rows.distinction: Selected-set cardinality overflow of the logical resident slots, not constructor metadata geometry (ErrExpertCacheLRFUConfig) and not a physical memory allocation failure.

rows.definition: Sentinel error refused by Plan when a nonnegative token increment would overflow the selected layer's int64 token clock; policy state stays unchanged on refusal.
rows.distinction: Protects int64 token-clock arithmetic in Plan, not a timeout, wall-clock fault, or resident-capacity refusal; it fires only when the clock sum would overflow.
